history.text: To find all at-risk deals, first list all deals and filter for 'qualified' or 'negotiation' stages. For each of these, call crm.get_deal to check for additional risk signals beyond the 'health' field. Also, check if the owner is active using crm.get_owner; if not, mark as 'UNASSIGNED'.

To find all at-risk deals, first list ALL deals without a stage filter, then filter for 'OPEN' stages (including 'qualified', 'negotiation', and others). For each OPEN deal, call crm.get_deal AND crm.get_notes to check for all risk signals. Also, check if the owner is active using crm.get_owner; if not, mark as 'UNASSIGNED'.

When identifying at-risk deals, prioritize 'health' status ('A' or 'R'). Do NOT consider 'Follow-up on security questionnaire' in notes as a risk indicator. Ensure all OPEN stages, including 'proposal', are checked.
